summary: Held through normal early chop (px oscillated -19 to -3 in first 4 minutes with PROPP/HA firing 'with' at times), which looked like a typical pullback-then-recover pattern. But at t=6-7m both HA and PROPP flipped to firing against in succession, ER10 collapsed to ~0.04-0.05 (no directional efficiency left), and price broke a new deep low of -46pts with giveback exceeding 114% of the recent leg amplitude -- a clean break past all prior support levels rather than another oscillation. That combination (two independent against-fires + efficiency collapse + support break) is what flagged wrong-direction, so I bailed at -46. Next time I'd watch for the ER10 collapse earlier as a leading warning before the price confirmation, and treat a giveback ratio crossing 100% as a hard alarm rather than waiting for it to compound further.
